selected_problem: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. Fresh-main inspection found that native fallback expansion used a weaker raw predicate than the federation that ultimately decides executability. A first implementation candidate containing path traversal, conflicting same-path operations, or more than the acceptance validation budget still looked executable to `nativeProposalExecutable`, suppressing the existing architecture/verifier fallback roles; federation then rejected that sole candidate, prematurely collapsing a synthesis attempt that still had reusable native roles available.

execution.route_basis: The newly merged main leaves native complex synthesis open and exposes one narrow, reproducible contradiction between candidate-expansion admission and federated executability. The defect is high-centrality to autonomous synthesis convergence, locally falsifiable, and fixable by reusing existing normalization rather than prescribing a new architecture, so source-contract replay routes to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced mode rotation.

asset_reuse: Reused `normalizeProposal` from `core/federated-generation.mjs` as the existing executable-candidate normalization contract.
Reused the existing implementation/architecture/verifier native role expansion; no new roles, provider, model, product form, or synthesis architecture was introduced.
changes: `nativeProposalExecutable` now normalizes the first native proposal with the same federation contract before deciding whether fallback roles can be skipped.
Unsafe-path, validation-overflow, and ambiguous-path implementation proposals no longer suppress architecture/verifier fallback expansion.
Explicit `DWAC_NATIVE_CANDIDATE_COUNT` operator overrides retain their existing bounded behavior.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: REPRODUCED against fresh main: focused regression 0/1 PASS. Unsafe traversal, 9-command overflow, and same-path conflicting proposals all returned `nativeProposalExecutable=true`, so automatic fallback roles were suppressed even though federation would reject them.

truth_boundaries: Arbitrary complex repository synthesis remains UNRESOLVED. This improves native candidate recovery when the first role emits a non-executable proposal; it does not guarantee that fallback roles will produce semantically correct code.
The automatic fallback decision now matches current federation normalization, but future changes to federation executability should remain synchronized with this admission contract.
External accelerators remain optional and are not required for the core fallback behavior verified here.
BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: GitHub's merge REST endpoint still lacks an atomic expected-base-SHA precondition, so external GET-to-PUT base races remain outside client-side elimination.
